bio.text: Danny Burgess represents District 23 in the Florida Senate, to which Burgess was elected in 2020 and reelected subsequently; the district covers parts of Hillsborough and Pasco counties.

Burgess served in the Florida House of Representatives from 2014 to 2019, was executive director of the Florida Department of Veterans' Affairs from 2019 to 2020, and was Zephyrhills mayor from 2013 to 2014.
Burgess is an attorney and was born in Zephyrhills, Florida. Burgess holds a B.A. from the University of South Florida (2008) and a J.D. from Barry University School of Law (2011).
Burgess has served in the U.S. Army Reserve since 2012 and holds the rank of major.
